standard.summary: 使用哪些 DiT 层特征，逗号分隔 (如 "4,8,12")。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Which DiT layers' features to use, comma-separated (such as "4,8,12").
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 使用哪些 DiT 层特征，逗号分隔 (如 "4,8,12")。需与 Multi-Scale 层对齐。

advanced_en.principle: Which DiT layer features to use, comma-separated (e.g. "4,8,12"). Must align with the Multi-Scale layers.
